lead: Nigeria's public debt rose to N166.79 trillion at the end of June, while domestic debt service fell almost a third in the second quarter. Cholera killed two inmates at Kano's Kurmawa custodial centre, and diphtheria deaths in Plateau reached 31. Femi Gbajabiamila said investigations had cleared him over the fake investment council, Abia Governor Alex Otti said the fuel subsidy should not return, and the naira firmed after the CBN's rate cut.

items.h: Public debt rises to N166.79trn
items.s: Debt Management Office data showed total public debt at 30 June 2026 was N7.44 trillion higher than three months earlier.

items.h: Domestic debt service falls 31.8% to N2.14trn
items.s: Payments in the second quarter dropped from N3.14 trillion in the first quarter, the DMO said.

items.h: Cholera kills two inmates in Kano prison
items.s: The Correctional Service confirmed two deaths and said the outbreak at the Kurmawa centre is under control.

items.h: Plateau diphtheria deaths reach 31
items.s: Health Commissioner Nicholas Ba'amlong said 469 suspected cases have been recorded across ten local government areas.

items.h: Gbajabiamila says probes cleared him over fake investment council
items.s: The President's chief of staff said police, DSS and ICPC investigations found no link between him and the council.

items.h: Otti backs subsidy removal and warns against its return
items.s: The Abia governor said subsidy promotes inefficiency and corruption, and clarified his support for Tinubu.

items.h: Naira firms after rate cut as FX turnover rises 9%
items.s: The currency strengthened after the CBN lowered its policy rate from 26.5 to 23 per cent.

items.h: Lagos police arrest six over N20bn goods diversion
items.s: The syndicate is accused of diverting imported consignments over about 19 years.

items.h: Super Eagles come from behind to beat Madagascar
items.s: Nigeria won 2-1 in Uyo to start their 2027 AFCON qualifying campaign.

items.h: Wike to lead Tinubu campaign in FCT and Rivers
items.s: The FCT minister said he will personally run the re-election effort in both places.

items.h: APC chairman says opposition going nowhere
items.s: Nentawe Yilwatda said Atiku's own local government voted APC in last week's by-election, as party leaders met in Maiduguri.

items.h: Akume tells MDA heads to campaign for Tinubu
items.s: The SGF asked agency chiefs to start grassroots campaigns.

items.h: Sanwo-Olu and Gbajabiamila urge Tinubu's re-election
items.s: They said the administration's policies will improve lives.

items.h: Atiku campaign to add more names and expand policy team
items.s: The ADC campaign council said further appointments will follow.

items.h: Omo-Agege says Supreme Court ruling did not disqualify him
items.s: The former Deputy Senate President said he can still contest Delta Central.

items.h: Soludo aide disputes Obi's godparent claim
items.s: Nonye Soludo's media aide said Obi and his wife are not godparents to the governor's children.

items.h: Shettima urges new ECOWAS team to prioritise integration
items.s: The Vice President charged the commission's leadership on regional unity.

items.h: UK passport exercise extended to 30 October
items.s: The Immigration Service cited high turnout.

items.h: NIS denies issuing passport to realtor during trial
items.s: The service said no court order restricting Rebecca Godwin-Isaac's travel was served on it.

items.h: Bandits abduct five in Tsafe
items.s: Women were among those taken in a midnight attack on the town.

items.h: Troops rescue six kidnap victims in Benue
items.s: Operation Whirl Stroke freed them near Gbise, Katsina-Ala.

items.h: Police arrest woman over lover's death in Abuja hotel
items.s: Police said the man found under Katampe Bridge died in a Gwarimpa guest house.

items.h: Flood sweeps undergraduate to death in Delta
items.s: Her father was hospitalised.

items.h: Experts say $1trn target needs 28% annual growth
items.s: They said reaching the 2030 goal is a steep climb.

items.h: Nigeria's 44 minerals can tackle poverty, Wunti says
items.s: The World Energy Council Nigeria chief urged local processing.

items.h: New Calabar nautical charts due on 1 October
items.s: The hydrographic agency will release three charts.

items.h: Kaduna holds prayers ahead of 66th Independence Day
items.s: Special prayers were held at Sultan Bello mosque.

items.h: Osinachi Ohale ends 16-year Super Falcons career
items.s: The defender won five AFCON titles.

items.h: NPFL leaders seek to extend unbeaten runs
items.s: Four clubs are unbeaten after five rounds.

items.h: Tenth woman's body found in Ekurhuleni
items.s: South African police are investigating the deaths.
